description: Add comprehensive JSDoc documentation to three TypeScript utility functions in /home/ga/workspace/utils/helpers.ts. The functions are: (1) formatCurrency(amount: number, locale?: string): string - formats numbers as currency, (2) debounce<T>(func: T, wait: number): T - creates debounced function wrapper, (3) deepMerge(target: any, source: any): any - recursively merges objects. For EACH function add: JSDoc comment block with description, @param tags for each parameter with descriptions, @returns tag with return value description, and @example tag with usage example (required for formatCurrency and debounce, optional for deepMerge).
